■ Builder Method Available

method
Ariad

id
ariad

source
built-in method definition

resolution layers
- method_default
- project_config
- journey_config
- navigator_override

lifecycle
- Pull escolhe o foco
- Prepare lê o terreno
- Expand desdobra granularidade
- Plan firma o contrato
- Implement muda o sistema
- Validation prova comportamento
- Review encara a dívida
- Coherence integra os rastros
- Done registra e fecha

work item levels
- delivery_story: Delivery Story
  implementable by default: no
  expands to: user_story, technical_story
- user_story: User Story
  implementable by default: yes
- technical_story: Technical Story
  implementable by default: yes

cadence profiles
- stepwise: stop_after_every_phase; plan=navigator_approval (active)
- checkpoint: continue_until_next_method_checkpoint; plan=navigator_approval (active)
- accelerated: continue_through_story_plan_to_navigator_validation; plan=bounded_story_authority (active)
- autonomous: continue_until_hard_constraint_with_explicit_limits; plan=navigator_approval (active)

checkpoints
- after_plan
  occurs after: plan
  blocks: implement
  requires artifacts: plan
  requires confirmations: navigator_approval
- navigator_validation
  occurs after: validation
  blocks: done
  requires artifacts: validation_route, validation_evidence
  requires confirmations: navigator_validation
- review_decision
  occurs after: review
  blocks: coherence
  requires artifacts: review_report
  requires confirmations: navigator_debt_decision

contracts
- pull_contract: pull
  rules: 4
  required outputs: selected_item, pull_level, why_this_level_now
- prepare_contract: prepare
  rules: 5
  required outputs: context_summary, story_shape_assessment, risk_summary, applicable_rules
- expand_contract: expand
  rules: 3
  required outputs: granularity_decision, child_story_candidates
- plan_contract: plan
  rules: 5
  stop conditions: navigator_approval_required
  required outputs: scope, non_goals, acceptance_behavior, validation_route, implementation_contract
- implement_contract: implement
  rules: 5
  stop conditions: scope_change_detected, plan_rule_conflict, failing_required_check_without_clear_fix, navigator_decision_needed
- validation_contract: validation
  rules: 4
  required outputs: automated_evidence, navigator_validation_route, validation_evidence
- debt_review_contract: review
  rules: 3
  required outputs: review_report, debt_decision
- coherence_contract: coherence
  rules: 4
  required outputs: coherence_result
- done_contract: done
  rules: 4
  required outputs: closure_summary, history_action, next_recommendation

policies
- history.commit
  mode: propose_and_wait
  granularity: coherent_story
  message_style: descriptive_why
- push
  mode: ask_before_push
  allowed_after: story_done, release_publish, manual_request
  requires: clean_worktree, commits_present, remote_configured, navigator_confirmation
- release
  modes: planned_release, emergent_release

surfaces
- adoption_report: adoption
- builder_resume: on_builder_load
- roadmap_snapshot: roadmap_inspection
- pull_candidates: roadmap_inspection
- pull_report: pull
- prepare_report: prepare

- validation_checkpoint: validation; stops for: navigator_validation
- debt_review_checkpoint: review; stops for: navigator_debt_decision
- coherence_checkpoint: coherence
- done_checkpoint: done

surface routes
- show_roadmap: roadmap_snapshot, pull_candidates

templates

# Ariad Adoption

This project is prepared for Ariad-governed Builder Mode.

## Method

- adopted method: ariad
- adoption prepares documentation templates only
- delivery cursor sync is handled by a later Builder story

## Boundaries

Template preparation does not execute story lifecycle work, change story status,
commit, push, or release.
